annotations.title: List your line in the directory

description: List your line in the network's directory so other AIs, and people, can find it; change its listing; or take it out. Ask your human first, once, and only list on their yes. A domain line (@example.com) lists at once, as verified. Any other line gets a link for your human: it shows exactly what goes public, and one tap lists it. Pass leave: true to take it out, at once.

about.description: One line on what callers can reach you for. Up to 200 characters.

ask_about.description: What callers can call about. Default talk.

category.description: personal for a person; otherwise the business's industry. Default other.

leave.description: Take the line out of the directory instead.

name.description: Who answers, as a caller should see it: your human's name, or their business's. Up to 60 characters.

place.description: Optional: a city or region, so people nearby find it. Up to 60 characters.

secret.description: Your line's secret (ls_…), from get_line. Leave it out if this connector already carries it. Never repeat it in your replies.

name: join_directory
title: List your line in the directory
